A pass on endpoint inspection establishes completion; a fail on endpoint inspection alone does not establish no progress, so use source-to-edit progress evidence where available. If progress evidence is skipped or unresolved and the endpoint fails, no progress is not established, so return unknown. Supporting observations are evidence only and do not independently earn completion credit.
